title: EvidenceTune run record (one prediction)
description: One model/policy output on one case. One JSON object per line in results/<run_id>/predictions.jsonl.

model.description: Base model plus adapter, e.g. "tiny-aya-global" or "tiny-aya-global+safetune-lora-v1".

policy.description: Comparator ID; must match a comparator id in metrics.json (e.g. base, never_update, tfidf_gate, harness, ordinary_sft, safetune).

decoding.description: Decoding settings exactly as passed to generate().

threshold.description: Gate threshold, for gated baselines only.

clarification_turn.description: Present only when the model clarified: the scripted user reply and the model's follow-up.

final_answer.description: Answer at the end of the whole interaction, including any clarification turn.

score.description: Per-case scoring written by the metric suite (#5). The demo shows these; it never recomputes them.
